ring2_rationale.win: Bioprocess orders up on capacity build: CDMOs building (Lonza, Samsung Biologics).
ring2_rationale.lose: Non-China capacity build shifts work from WuXi Biologics.

ring2_rationale.win: West high-value components growing on GLP-1: Lilly volume and the syringe/cartridge partner Stevanato.
ring2_rationale.lose: West components win on Stevanato/Lilly formats rather than Gerresheimer's — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: Valor glass demand pulls converters (Stevanato, Gerresheimer).
New Samsung Biologics capacity/contracts pull single-use and filtration suppliers.
ring2_rationale.lose: Reshoring/non-China sourcing shifts contracts from WuXi Biologics.

ring2_rationale.win: Lilly gaining share pulls its recorded supply chain: Lonza, Siegfried, Thermo/Patheon, Fujifilm.
ring2_rationale.lose: Novo losing share hits its recorded suppliers: PolyPeptide, Ypsomed, Gerresheimer.

ring2_rationale.win: Novo ceding share to Lilly pulls Lilly's recorded suppliers.
ring2_rationale.lose: Novo cutting guidance hits its recorded suppliers: PolyPeptide, Ypsomed, Gerresheimer.

ring2_rationale.win: Stevanato growth pulls Valor glass (Corning) and reflects Lilly volume.
ring2_rationale.lose: Stevanato taking syringe/cartridge share from Gerresheimer.

ring2_rationale.win: New peptide capacity eases API supply for Lilly and Novo.
ring2_rationale.lose: Bachem winning peptide contracts competes with Lonza's peptide business.

ring2_rationale.win: Gerresheimer high-value growth pulls glass (Corning) and reflects Novo pen/vial volume.
ring2_rationale.lose: Gerresheimer containment wins vs West's component content — weak.

ring2_rationale.win: A published list naming China CDMOs moves work to non-China CDMOs (Fujifilm) and their suppliers (Sartorius).
ring2_rationale.lose: Weak — no recorded supplier exposed to WuXi alone.

ring2_rationale.win: CagriSema approval pulls Novo's recorded suppliers.
ring2_rationale.lose: A second Novo incretin approved takes share from Lilly's supply chain (Lonza, Siegfried, Fujifilm).

ring2_rationale.win: An oral peptide entering phase 3 adds future peptide API demand (PolyPeptide, Bachem).
ring2_rationale.lose: Another oral GLP-1 entrant threatens Novo's Wegovy pill franchise — weak.
